title: The Articulate Chosen One
intro: In the shadow of a mountain where divine words descended, a people's faith wavered under the glint of gold. One soul, gifted with eloquence, stood as a support to a greater mission, yet faced a moment of profound testing. When the chosen messenger ascended to a sacred appointment, this figure remained behind, pleading with a restless nation. Who is this steadfast soul whose voice rose against idolatry?
clues: I was chosen by Allah to be a prophet, though my story is often told alongside another.
I was sent to a tyrant ruler, but my role was to support, not to lead.
I was gifted with eloquence, and my words were meant to soften hearts.
When my companion departed for a sacred appointment, I was left to guide a restless people.
In their impatience, they forged an image from their ornaments, and I pleaded with them to remain true to Allah.
My companion returned and seized me, but I explained that the people overpowered me and nearly killed me; I was not among the wrongdoers.

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
